support_claim: Commercial notes tie CRM OAK-77's stale English name to a documented rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH with unchanged HRB 88421, and billing invoices bill that same legal name.

steps.fact: CRM record OAK-77 lists the account name Oakfield Logistics.
Commercial notes document that Oakfield rebranded from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH and that CRM still shows the old English-facing name.
Commercial notes state that Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change through the rebrand.
Company registry row HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the registered legal name.
CRM OAK-77 refers to the legal counterparty that rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, because its listed name is the pre-rebrand English-facing CRM name described in the rebrand notes.
The unchanged HRB 88421 identifies the same legal entity before and after the rebrand to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH for the right-hand referent.
